roles.title: Product Manager (Mid and Senior Level Opportunities)

bullets: Ship product and deliver measurable impact, fast
Lead cross-functional groups to execute against company objectives
Communicate concisely and influence outcomes across all levels
Develop product roadmaps and build alignment across teams, cross-functional partners, and the executive team
Define and analyze the metrics that signal product success and health
